limits: Original DLL with native MSVC under Wine11.17, Wine builtin UCRT/OS services; no Windows parity. Int-only groups inspect only lower32 value bits, not unassigned upper stack bytes. Pointer values are opaque and never dereferenced. Double/pointer group bits are fully initialized. Group labels and JSON schema are independent research format. init.created and close.completed are event observations, not invented integer return values. Double push input fields are indices into fixed source input array. Comparator compares low-byte keys, records existing/candidate order, has no mutation/reentrancy.
